jobs.k1_finish: tall vertical picture: the main character has just arrived alone at a finish line, out of breath, standing on all four paws and looking at a finish tape that is already torn and hangs loose from two tall plain posts; the ground around it is covered with fallen confetti and two deflated balloons; far behind the finish, small happy figures of three people walk away into the distance: one carries a wedding bouquet, one rolls a travel suitcase, one holds up a small golden cup; one last round balloon on a string floats up alone in the plain sky high above the posts. The cat has sad tired eyes and lowered ears. The flame on the tip of its tail is a small dim ember. LAYOUT: the main character is whole and large in the lower third in the middle; the two posts with the torn tape stand on both sides of the cat in the middle of the picture; the three small people are in the upper middle, far away; the single floating balloon is in the upper part with wide plain sky around it; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k2_photo: tall vertical picture: the main character sits on a plain floor and holds one large wooden picture frame upright with both front paws, looking at the photo in it with soft surprised eyes and a tiny smile; the photo in the frame shows the same character a year ago, smaller and fluffier, sitting by a window with snow falling outside, hiding behind one plain closed envelope with only its scared eyes and ears showing. The flame on the tip of its tail burns medium and warm. LAYOUT: the frame with the photo is big and clearly visible in the upper half; the main character is whole in the lower half under the frame; plain paper around; the envelope is plain and unmarked; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k3_letters: tall vertical picture: the main character sits calmly and proudly on a plain floor among three opened plain envelopes, each with a blank letter pulled halfway out, one front paw resting on the nearest letter, chin up, eyes half closed with a small satisfied smile. The flame on the tip of its tail burns big, golden and bright with a few tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the main character is whole and large in the middle of the lower half; the three opened envelopes lie around it with small gaps; plain wall above with wide clean space; every letter is blank paper; no letters or numbers anywhere.
